description: Create new git branch stage-8-document-management and commit all changes
steps: Run `git checkout -b stage-8-document-management` to create the new branch from the current stage-7-settings-configuration
Run `git add -A` to stage all new and modified files
Run `git commit -m 'feat: add Document Management & Compliance module (Stage 8)'` to commit all changes
Do NOT push or create a PR
acceptance_criteria: A new branch 'stage-8-document-management' exists with all document management changes committed
No push or PR creation is performed
verification: Run `git branch` and confirm stage-8-document-management is the current branch
Run `git log --oneline -1` to confirm the commit exists
